commands.label: apk-structure
argv:
import hashlib, json, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("Tool/cases/leaf-apk/target/diva.apk")
d = p.read_bytes()
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    dex_names = sorted(n for n in names if n.startswith("classes") and n.endswith(".dex"))
    dex_name = dex_names[0] if dex_names else None
    dex = z.read(dex_name) if dex_name else b""
    lib_entries = sorted(n for n in names if n.startswith("lib/"))
    so_entries = sorted(n for n in names if n.lower().endswith(".so"))
markers = ["StubApp", "stubStubApp", "libjiagu", "DexHelper", "com.qihoo", "SecShell", "jiagu", "bangcle", "secneo", "libexec", "libshell", "AppWrapper", "aliprotect", "libnesec", "libshella", "libmobisec"]
hits = {m: dex.count(m.encode()) for m in markers}
print(json.dumps({"sha256": hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest(), "size": len(d), "entries": len(names), "dex": dex_names, "dex_0_size": len(dex), "dex_0_magic": dex[:4].hex() if dex else None, "dex_0_version": dex[4:8].hex() if dex else None, "lib_entries": lib_entries, "so_entries": so_entries, "harden_hits": hits, "harden_nonzero": sum(hits.values())}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

repro.evidence: R13 实际执行 ZIP/DEX 结构检查与 target/成品逐条目差异检查：target 有 379 条目、单个 classes.dex、零 lib/so 与零列名加固特征命中；两项命令 rc=0，两个绑定文件前后哈希一致。

lessons: 存在理由：给安卓普通 APK 提供可复核的载体基线，避免把加固或设备侧失败误归因于最基本的打包能力。
已证：target 是 379 条目、单个 classes.dex、无 lib/so，16 个列名加固特征计数为 0；结果见 capture/r13-apk-structure.stdout.txt。
已证：现有重打包成品可重算 size/sha256，历史 capture 记录了 zipalign 成功；案例内 MANIFEST 绑定成品字节。
